name: Qingci Games Inc.
summary: Qingci Games Inc., an investment holding company, develops, publishes, and operates mobile games in Mainland China, Japan, the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Hong Kong, Macau, Taiwan, and internationally. The company engages in the sale of in-game virtual items and game peripheral products; and licensing of self-developed games to third-party publishers. It also provides in-game advertising, marketing, and promotion services; and technical, product design, information, and management consultation services.
